evidence.explanation: The JS des.map wrapper invokes l_push_wid_hei_table; the C-only call-site edge does not mean callback dimensions are omitted.
evidence.proof: Six public JS map callbacks match exact C mapfrag_fromstr/stripdigits/str_lines_maxlen and l_push_wid_hei_table output. Three 3x2 floor representations (plain, trailing newline, ASCII digit labels), two interior positions; one callback with exactly width/height and unchanged painted extent. Fixed C typed table capture and fragment-to-descriptor handoff, not full C lspo_map execution.
evidence.control: Plain 3x2 maps at (10,5) and (20,8); trailing newline and numeric-label forms preserve width 3 / height 2.
